text:
elaine: Quick proposal — require provenance metadata on all per-org routing exceptions (who requested, how, approval id, TTL). Want to discuss before I draft the console + API changes.

 dan: +1 on provenance. two quick q's: 1) should provenance be mandatory for support-created exceptions? 2) default TTL?

 maria: For support-created I'd require a ticket id and agent id. Default TTL = 7d with option to set longer. UI should show expiration and a "make permanent (requires justification)" flow. :calendar:

 tom: Enterprise customers sometimes want permanent pins. We need an explicit legal/contract checkbox or a support escalation flow for long-lived overrides. Also need a revoke button that triggers rollback and notifies the customer.

 elaine: agree re: revoke. Proposal idea: exception record fields = {"org_id","creator","create_via","approval_id","reason","scope","match_rules","expires_at","revoke_state"}. create_via in ["console","api","support"].

 maria: love that. can we also store "requested_by" vs "approved_by" (two separate principals)? easier for audits.

 dan: ops question — enforcement order: should per-org exceptions outrank global routing priorities? i.e., sticky pin first, then route rules? we need deterministic ordering documented.

 tom: Per-org exceptions should be higher than generic routing rules but lower than emergency "breakglass" overrides. Otherwise customers will hide outages by pinning.

 elaine: +1 on ordering. propose: breakglass > per-org-exception > model-priority > default routing. add attribute "precedence" numeric for sorting.

 infra-bot: audit: created exception record ae-2005234001 by elaine via console (meta: {"ticket_id":null,"expires_at":"2025-03-15T12:00:00Z"})

 maria: small API note — make create_via immutable once created. otherwise provenance gets lost.

 dan: UX: console list should show filters: active, expired, pending-approval, created-via. Also a lightweight diff view showing affected route matching rules.

 elaine: sample JSON shape for the API (rough):
```json
{
  "org_id": "org_123",
  "creator": "elaine",
  "create_via": "console",
  "requested_by": "cust-admin@acme.com",
  "approved_by": "dan",
  "approval_id": "appr-987",
  "reason": "Failover to cpu-backed model pool for latency spike",
  "match_rules": [{"path_prefix":"/v1/generate","header":{"x-org-pin":"acme"}}],
  "precedence": 200,
  "expires_at": "2025-03-15T12:00:00Z",
  "revoke_state": "active"
}
```

 ops-bot: note: when expires_at is reached we should emit a route-config-change event and create a compliance ticket if exception was marked "permanent".

 maria: security ask — restrict who can create permanent exceptions. maybe role = "exception_admin" and require 2FA.

 elaine: action items: 1) I'll draft the API + console changes with the JSON schema above. 2) tom to write rollout doc for precedence & revoke playbook. 3) dan to add UI filters and diff view mockups. 4) infra to wire audit events -> compliance queue.

 dan: noted. I'll mock filters by EOD. :eye_speech_bubble:  

 tom: I'll take the revoke playbook, will include SLA for customer notification.

 infra-bot: info: created audit event ae-2005234002 linking exception ae-2005234001 to config revision rev-20250315-02

 elaine: thanks team — please add comments on the PR when I open it. planning design review next Tue. :thumbsup:
